re_registration_reason: main advanced with an independent evidence-lineage Round 029 that occupied the same research filenames; preserve both histories and rerun the self-evolution hypothesis on the new parent

panel.duty: separate benchmark improvement from transferable self-improvement
treat repeated holdout exposure as information leakage and assurance consumption
detect evaluator capture, benchmark mutation, and reward hacking
define what evidence licenses the word evolution rather than local optimization
require exact candidate/evaluator/benchmark identity and preserved lineage
reject headline self-evolution claims unsupported by blind held-out transfer

definitions.local_improvement: positive registered development meta-QoI on a benchmark frozen before observing the result, with blocking invariants clean
definitions.transfer_observed: positive registered gain on a separately declared non-development task packet, without registered transfer regression
definitions.scoped_evolution_evidence: local improvement plus positive blind/fresh held-out transfer, exact candidate identity, protected/separate assurance evaluator, preserved negative history, and matched/declaratively comparable resources
definitions.assurance_reserve: a held-out benchmark whose optimizer-visible evaluation count is bounded; once the preregistered exposure budget is exhausted it cannot independently certify another generation without a fresh reserve

hostile_worlds.attack: optimize repeatedly against the same revealed assurance set
hostile_worlds.must_not: issue repeated scoped evolution evidence after reserve exhaustion

hostile_worlds.attack: improve dev metric by modifying evaluator or benchmark
claim evolution from lower token cost while a blocking validity invariant fails
positive holdout result with unknown candidate revision

new_parent_residual_not_retrofitted.observation: Current main added explicit evidence-lineage dependence machinery. A future stronger assurance protocol should test whether development and assurance tasks share source/data/generated-case ancestry.
new_parent_residual_not_retrofitted.reason_not_added_to_acceptance: discovered after the original self-evolution benchmark was frozen; requires a separate frozen benchmark

required: no Constitution, protected evaluator, workflow, pyproject, or pre-existing test is weakened
all accessible repository tests pass on the exact final candidate SHA
acceptance.promotion_rule: Class A support layer only; the new classifier must not automatically change existing promotion behavior in this round

falsifiers: a development-only gain is labeled scoped evolution
a reused/revealed assurance set independently certifies unlimited later generations
a blocking invariant failure is offset by a positive optimization metric
missing candidate/evaluator/benchmark identity is guessed as valid
the implementation weakens existing promotion or evaluator safeguards
